title: Postponement Length and the Outpatient Surgery Late-Change Fee — Good Faith & Price Estimates
content:
**Q. How does the length of the postponement bear on the late-change fee of a moved Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking under Good Faith & Price Estimates?**

The postponement days run from the original slot date to the new scheduled service date, the slot date not counted and the new date counted, a new date earlier than the slot date counting as zero postponement days. Fourteen or fewer postponement days keep one half (0.5) of the fee basis; fifteen to thirty-five keep three quarters (0.75); more than thirty-five keep all of it. The original slot date is the scheduled date of the patient's Outpatient Procedure Appointment in Appointment Scheduling that shows cancelled by the patient (the first one listed where there are several); the new scheduled service date is the date on the estimate's current version.

| Postponement days | Share of the fee basis kept |
|---|---|
| 0 to 14 (an earlier new date counts as 0) | one half (0.5) |
| 15 to 35 | three quarters (0.75) |
| more than 35 | all of it |

**Q. Where are the edges?** (hypothetical) New date 14 days after the slot: one half. 15 days: three quarters. 35 days: three quarters. 36 days: all of it. New date 3 days before the slot: zero postponement days, one half.
